papers.title: TradingAgents: Multi-Agents LLM Financial Trading Framework
papers.summary:
Significant progress has been made in automated problem-solving using
societies of agents powered by large language models (LLMs). In finance,
efforts have largely focused on single-agent systems handling specific tasks or
multi-agent frameworks independently gathering data. However, the multi-agent
systems' potential to replicate real-world trading firms' collaborative
dynamics remains underexplored. TradingAgents proposes a novel stock trading
framework inspired by trading firms, featuring LLM-powered agents in
specialized roles such as fundamental analysts, sentiment analysts, technical
analysts, and traders with varied risk profiles. The framework includes Bull
and Bear researcher agents assessing market conditions, a risk management team
monitoring exposure, and traders synthesizing insights from debates and
historical data to make informed decisions. By simulating a dynamic,
collaborative trading environment, this framework aims to improve trading
performance. Detailed architecture and extensive experiments reveal its
superiority over baseline models, with notable improvements in cumulative
returns, Sharpe ratio, and maximum drawdown, highlighting the potential of
multi-agent LLM frameworks in financial trading. TradingAgents is available at
https://github.com/TauricResearch/TradingAgents.
papers.summaryZh:
使用自动化解决问题取得了重大进展
由大型语言模型 (LLM) 提供支持的代理协会。在金融领域，
工作主要集中在处理特定任务的单代理系统或
多代理框架独立收集数据。然而，多代理
系统复制现实世界贸易公司协作的潜力
动力学仍有待探索。 TradingAgents 提出了一种新颖的股票交易方式
受贸易公司启发的框架，以法学硕士支持的代理为特色
专业角色，例如基本面分析师、情绪分析师、技术分析师
具有不同风险状况的分析师和交易员。该框架包括 Bull
贝尔斯登研究人员评估市场状况，风险管理团队
监控风险敞口，交易者从辩论中综合见解
历史数据以做出明智的决策。通过模拟动态，
协作交易环境，该框架旨在改善交易
性能。详细的架构和广泛的实验揭示了它的
优于基线模型，累积显着改进
回报率、夏普比率和最大回撤，凸显了
金融交易中的多代理法学硕士框架。交易代理可在
https://github.com/TauricResearch/TradingAgents。

papers.title: Harness^2: Recursive Agent Harnessing for an Open World
papers.summary: LLM agents' capabilities depend not only on their underlying models but also on their execution harnesses. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) offers a promising approach to automatically evolve these harnesses. However, deploying RSI in open-world settings still faces two critical challenges. First, open-world tasks are typically unseen during the harness design phase and novel at test time, leaving no ground-truth verifiers to reliably guide online harness edits. Second, the RSI process remains highly task-specific and fails to generalize to novel scenarios. We introduce Harness^2, a plug-and-play, recursive agent harnessing framework that addresses these challenges through two connected levels of recursion. Task-level recursion refines the current task's harness using a contrastive Propose-Probe-Compose step that reliably guides edits without ground-truth verifiers, and can be scaled further via parallel or sequential recursion. Harnessing-level recursion then extracts experience from these edits to update a continual improvement harness, enabling the agent to better adapt to future tasks. Across three professional benchmarks and four model-harness configurations, a single step consistently improves GLM-5 and Gemini 3.5 Flash over their base harnesses, yielding gains of up to 11.5 points on WorkBuddy-Bench, 4.5 points on JobBench, and 11.8 percentage points on LAB, with further gains as the task-level recursion budget increases.
papers.summaryZh: LLM 代理的能力不仅取决于其底层模型，还取决于其执行工具。递归自我改进（RSI）提供了一种有前途的方法来自动改进这些工具。然而，在开放世界环境中部署 RSI 仍然面临两个关键挑战。首先，开放世界任务通常在线束设计阶段是看不见的，并且在测试时是新颖的，因此没有真实的验证者来可靠地指导在线线束编辑。其次，RSI 过程仍然高度特定于任务，无法推广到新场景。我们引入了 Harness^2，这是一个即插即用的递归代理利用框架，它通过两个连接的递归级别来解决这些挑战。任务级递归使用对比性的 Propose-Probe-Compose 步骤来细化当前任务的控制，该步骤可以在没有真实验证器的情况下可靠地指导编辑，并且可以通过并行或顺序递归进一步扩展。然后，利用级递归从这些编辑中提取经验，以更新持续改进的利用，使代理能够更好地适应未来的任务。在三个专业基准测试和四种模型线束配置中，一步即可持续改进 GLM-5 和 Gemini 3.5 Flash 的基本线束，在 WorkBuddy-Bench 上获得高达 11.5 个百分点的收益，在 JobBench 上获得 4.5 个百分点，在 LAB 上获得 11.8 个百分点，并且随着任务级递归预算的增加，收益还会进一步增加。
papers.titleZh: Harness^2：开放世界的递归代理利用

papers.title: The Other Half of the Memory Wall: Serving 35B MoEs from SSD with Trained Routing Prediction
papers.summary:
Mixture-of-experts (MoE) inference on consumer hardware is bounded by weight memory: a 35B-class model is 19.5GB at 4-bit, and sparsity shrinks the compute per token, not the bytes that must be held. Naive offloading to SSD does not help on its own, because layer N+1's experts must be chosen before layer N's output exists, so the reads cannot start early enough to hide behind compute. We present Edge0, a streaming MoE inference engine that closes the gap with a prerouter: a per-layer head predicts the next layer's routing one token ahead, and the prediction is consumed as the routing itself, so the staged expert set equals the routed set and nothing is dropped. An unmerged recovery LoRA, trained on the student path, pays back the quality lost to int4 quantization and routing replacement. On a single 24GB machine, Edge0
  serves a 35B MoE at 20tok/s inside 3GiB of peak active memory, within a few points of its fp16 teacher on average across five public benchmarks. An 8B tier runs on the same framework, and the framework, checkpoints, and adapters are open source.
papers.summaryZh:
消费者硬件上的专家混合 (MoE) 推理受到权重内存的限制：35B 级模型在 4 位时为 19.5GB，稀疏性会缩小每个令牌的计算量，而不是必须保存的字节数。单纯卸载到 SSD 本身并没有什么帮助，因为必须在 N 层输出存在之前选择 N+1 层的专家，因此读取不能太早开始以隐藏在计算后面。我们提出了 Edge0，一个流式 MoE 推理引擎，它缩小了与预路由器的差距：每层头提前一个令牌预测下一层的路由，并且预测被用作路由本身，因此分阶段专家集等于路由集，并且不会丢失任何内容。未合并的恢复 LoRA，在学生路径上进行训练，弥补了 int4 量化和路由替换造成的质量损失。在单个 24GB 机器上，Edge0
  在 3GiB 峰值活动内存内以 20tok/s 的速度提供 35B MoE，在五个公共基准测试中，其 fp16 老师的平均值仅相差几个点。 8B 层运行在同一框架上，并且框架、检查点和适​​配器都是开源的。
papers.titleZh: 内存墙的另一半：通过经过训练的路由预测从 SSD 为 35B MoE 提供服务

papers.title: Unlimited OCR Works
papers.summary: Recently, end-to-end OCR models, exemplified by DeepSeek OCR, have once again thrust OCR into the spotlight. A widely held view is that employing a large language model (LLM) as the decoder allows the model to leverage the prior distribution of language, leading to improved OCR performance. However, the downside is equally evident: as the output sequence lengthens, the accumulated KV cache drives up memory consumption and progressively slows down generation. This stands in stark contrast to humans, who exhibit no such decline in efficiency during long-horizon copying tasks. In this technical report, we propose Unlimited OCR, a model designed to emulate human parsing working memory. Taking DeepSeek OCR as the baseline, we replace all attention layers in the decoder with our proposed Reference Sliding Window Attention (R-SWA), which reduces attention computation costs while maintaining a constant KV cache throughout the entire decoding process. By combining the high compression rate of DeepSeek OCR's encoder with our constant KV cache design, Unlimited OCR can transcribe dozens of pages of documents in a single forward pass under a standard maximum length of 32K. More importantly, R-SWA is a general-purpose parsing attention mechanism - beyond OCR, it is equally applicable to tasks such as ASR, translation, etc. Codes and model weights are publicly available at http://github.com/baidu/Unlimited-OCR.
papers.summaryZh: 最近，以DeepSeek OCR为代表的端到端OCR模型再次将OCR推向了人们的视线。一种广泛持有的观点是，采用大型语言模型 (LLM) 作为解码器允许模型利用语言的先验分布，从而提高 OCR 性能。然而，缺点也同样明显：随着输出序列的延长，累积的 KV 缓存会增加内存消耗并逐渐减慢生成速度。这与人类形成鲜明对比，人类在执行长视距复制任务时并没有表现出效率下降的情况。在这份技术报告中，我们提出了 Unlimited OCR，一种旨在模拟人类解析工作记忆的模型。以 DeepSeek OCR 为基准，我们用我们提出的参考滑动窗口注意力（R-SWA）替换解码器中的所有注意力层，这降低了注意力计算成本，同时在整个解码过程中保持恒定的 KV 缓存。通过将 DeepSeek OCR 编码器的高压缩率与我们的恒定 KV 缓存设计相结合，Unlimited OCR 可以在标准最大长度 32K 的情况下在单次前向传递中转录数十页文档。更重要的是，R-SWA 是一种通用的解析注意力机制——除了 OCR 之外，它同样适用于 ASR、翻译等任务。代码和模型权重可在 http://github.com/baidu/Unlimited-OCR 上公开。

papers.title: TokenEconomizer: Experience-Driven Black-Box Cost Control for Coding Agents
papers.summary: Advances in frontier coding agents have sharply increased the token costs of AI-assisted software engineering. Their token efficiency is typically evaluated on isolated tasks, whereas real-world developers use them to continuously build, update, and maintain large-scale projects. This mismatch motivates us to evaluate agents over sequences of realistic coding tasks, where we find that agents exhibit recurring environment-dependent token costs that existing methods struggle to reduce. To minimize these costs, we introduce TokenEconomizer, an external controller that cuts environment-specific token costs over a sequence of tasks. These cuts come from determining (i) which operational micro-skills to inject, (ii) which persistently irrelevant tools to prune, and (iii) when to intervene in unproductive failure loops. Across Claude Code, Codex, and GitHub Copilot CLI paired with frontier models, TokenEconomizer reduces the average token cost by 18.4-30.9% with comparable task success. Savings hold in every repository under every tested agent-model setting and generalize to diverse domains such as sequential web development and security auditing, where costs fall by 6.4-21.2% depending on task structure. Our work establishes adaptive black-box cost control as a promising direction for reducing token costs of coding agents in realistic settings.
papers.summaryZh: 前沿编码代理的进步极大地增加了人工智能辅助软件工程的代币成本。它们的代币效率通常是在孤立的任务上评估的，而现实世界的开发人员使用它们来持续构建、更新和维护大型项目。这种不匹配促使我们通过实际编码任务序列来评估智能体，我们发现智能体表现出反复出现的依赖于环境的令牌成本，而现有方法很难降低这种成本。为了最大限度地降低这些成本，我们引入了 TokenEconomizer，这是一个外部控制器，可以降低一系列任务中特定于环境的令牌成本。这些削减来自于确定（i）注入哪些操作微观技能，（ii）修剪哪些持续不相关的工具，以及（iii）何时干预非生产性故障循环。在与前沿模型配对的 Claude Code、Codex 和 GitHub Copilot CLI 中，TokenEconomizer 将平均代币成本降低了 18.4-30.9%，并且任务成功率相当。在每个经过测试的代理模型设置下的每个存储库中都可以节省成本，并推广到不同的领域，例如顺序 Web 开发和安全审计，其中成本下降了 6.4-21.2%，具体取决于任务结构。我们的工作将自适应黑盒成本控制作为降低现实环境中编码代理的令牌成本的一个有前途的方向。
papers.titleZh: TokenEconomizer：编码代理的经验驱动黑盒成本控制

papers.title: Very Large-Scale Multi-Agent Simulation in AgentScope
papers.summary:
Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have opened new avenues for
applying multi-agent systems in very large-scale simulations. However, there
remain several challenges when conducting multi-agent simulations with existing
platforms, such as limited scalability and low efficiency, unsatisfied agent
diversity, and effort-intensive management processes. To address these
challenges, we develop several new features and components for AgentScope, a
user-friendly multi-agent platform, enhancing its convenience and flexibility
for supporting very large-scale multi-agent simulations. Specifically, we
propose an actor-based distributed mechanism as the underlying technological
infrastructure towards great scalability and high efficiency, and provide
flexible environment support for simulating various real-world scenarios, which
enables parallel execution of multiple agents, centralized workflow
orchestration, and both inter-agent and agent-environment interactions among
agents. Moreover, we integrate an easy-to-use configurable tool and an
automatic background generation pipeline in AgentScope, simplifying the process
of creating agents with diverse yet detailed background settings. Last but not
least, we provide a web-based interface for conveniently monitoring and
managing a large number of agents that might deploy across multiple devices. We
conduct a comprehensive simulation to demonstrate the effectiveness of the
proposed enhancements in AgentScope, and provide detailed observations and
discussions to highlight the great potential of applying multi-agent systems in
large-scale simulations. The source code is released on GitHub at
https://github.com/modelscope/agentscope to inspire further research and
development in large-scale multi-agent simulations.
papers.summaryZh:
大语言模型 (LLM) 的最新进展为
在超大规模模拟中应用多智能体系统。然而，有
在利用现有技术进行多智能体模拟时仍然面临一些挑战
平台，如可扩展性有限、效率低下、代理不满意
多样性和努力密集型的管理流程。为了解决这些
挑战，我们为 AgentScope 开发了几个新功能和组件，
用户友好的多代理平台，增强其便利性和灵活性
用于支持超大规模的多智能体模拟。具体来说，我们
提出基于参与者的分布式机制作为底层技术
基础设施具有良好的可扩展性和高效率，并提供
灵活的环境支持模拟各种现实场景，
支持多个代理并行执行、集中工作流程
编排，以及代理间和代理与环境之间的交互
代理。此外，我们集成了一个易于使用的可配置工具和一个
AgentScope中自动后台生成管道，简化流程
创建具有多样化但详细的背景设置的代理。最后但不是
至少，我们提供了一个基于网络的界面，可以方便地监控和
管理可能跨多个设备部署的大量代理。我们
进行全面的模拟以证明其有效性
AgentScope 中提出的增强功能，并提供详细的观察结果和
讨论强调了应用多智能体系统的巨大潜力
大规模模拟。源代码发布在 GitHub 上：
https://github.com/modelscope/agentscope 激发进一步的研究和
大规模多智能体模拟的发展。
papers.titleZh: AgentScope 中的超大规模多智能体模拟

papers.title:
AgentScope 1.0: A Developer-Centric Framework for Building Agentic
  Applications
papers.summary:
Driven by rapid advancements of Large Language Models (LLMs), agents are
empowered to combine intrinsic knowledge with dynamic tool use, greatly
enhancing their capacity to address real-world tasks. In line with such an
evolution, AgentScope introduces major improvements in a new version (1.0),
towards comprehensively supporting flexible and efficient tool-based
agent-environment interactions for building agentic applications. Specifically,
we abstract foundational components essential for agentic applications and
provide unified interfaces and extensible modules, enabling developers to
easily leverage the latest progress, such as new models and MCPs. Furthermore,
we ground agent behaviors in the ReAct paradigm and offer advanced agent-level
infrastructure based on a systematic asynchronous design, which enriches both
human-agent and agent-agent interaction patterns while improving execution
efficiency. Building on this foundation, we integrate several built-in agents
tailored to specific practical scenarios. AgentScope also includes robust
engineering support for developer-friendly experiences. We provide a scalable
evaluation module with a visual studio interface, making the development of
long-trajectory agentic applications more manageable and easier to trace. In
addition, AgentScope offers a runtime sandbox to ensure safe agent execution
and facilitates rapid deployment in production environments. With these
enhancements, AgentScope provides a practical foundation for building scalable,
adaptive, and effective agentic applications.
papers.summaryZh:
在大型语言模型 (LLM) 快速发展的推动下，代理正在
能够将内在知识与动态工具的使用结合起来，极大地
增强他们解决现实世界任务的能力。符合这样一个
演变，AgentScope 在新版本 (1.0) 中引入了重大改进，
全面支持灵活高效的工具化
用于构建代理应用程序的代理与环境交互。具体来说，
我们抽象了代理应用程序所必需的基础组件，并且
提供统一的接口和可扩展的模块，方便开发者
轻松利用最新进展，例如新模型和 MCP。此外，
我们将代理行为置于 ReAct 范式中，并提供高级代理级别
基于系统异步设计的基础设施，丰富了两者
人与代理和代理与代理交互模式，同时提高执行力
效率。在此基础上，我们集成了多个内置代理
针对具体的实际场景进行定制。 AgentScope 还包括强大的
为开发人员提供友好体验的工程支持。我们提供可扩展的
具有 Visual Studio 界面的评估模块，使得开发
长轨迹代理应用程序更易于管理和跟踪。在
此外，AgentScope 还提供运行时沙箱以确保安全代理执行
并有利于生产环境中的快速部署。有了这些
增强功能，AgentScope 为构建可扩展、
自适应且有效的代理应用程序。
papers.titleZh:
AgentScope 1.0：以开发人员为中心的 Agentic 构建框架
  应用领域

papers.title: Kronos: A Foundation Model for the Language of Financial Markets
papers.summary:
The success of large-scale pre-training paradigm, exemplified by Large
Language Models (LLMs), has inspired the development of Time Series Foundation
Models (TSFMs). However, their application to financial candlestick (K-line)
data remains limited, often underperforming non-pre-trained architectures.
Moreover, existing TSFMs often overlook crucial downstream tasks such as
volatility prediction and synthetic data generation. To address these
limitations, we propose Kronos, a unified, scalable pre-training framework
tailored to financial K-line modeling. Kronos introduces a specialized
tokenizer that discretizes continuous market information into token sequences,
preserving both price dynamics and trade activity patterns. We pre-train Kronos
using an autoregressive objective on a massive, multi-market corpus of over 12
billion K-line records from 45 global exchanges, enabling it to learn nuanced
temporal and cross-asset representations. Kronos excels in a zero-shot setting
across a diverse set of financial tasks. On benchmark datasets, Kronos boosts
price series forecasting RankIC by 93% over the leading TSFM and 87% over the
best non-pre-trained baseline. It also achieves a 9% lower MAE in volatility
forecasting and a 22% improvement in generative fidelity for synthetic K-line
sequences. These results establish Kronos as a robust, versatile foundation
model for end-to-end financial time series analysis. Our pre-trained model is
publicly available at https://github.com/shiyu-coder/Kronos.
papers.summaryZh:
大规模预训练范式的成功，以 Large 为例
语言模型（LLM）启发了时间序列基金会的发展
模型 (TSFM)。然而，它们在金融烛台（K 线）中的应用
数据仍然有限，通常表现不佳非预先训练的架构。
此外，现有的 TSFM 常常忽视关键的下游任务，例如
波动率预测和合成数据生成。为了解决这些
针对局限性，我们提出了 Kronos，一个统一的、可扩展的预训练框架
为金融K线建模量身定制。 Kronos 推出了专门的
标记器将连续的市场信息离散化为标记序列，
保持价格动态和贸易活动模式。我们预训练 Kronos
在超过 12 个的庞大、多市场语料库上使用自回归目标
全球45家交易所十亿K线记录，细致入微
时间和跨资产表示。 Kronos 擅长零射击设置
跨越一系列不同的财务任务。在基准数据集上，Kronos 有所提升
价格系列预测 RankIC 比领先的 TSFM 高 93%，比领先的 TSFM 高 87%
最佳非预训练基线。它还实现了波动性 MAE 降低 9%
预测，合成 K 线的生成保真度提高 22%
序列。这些结果使 Kronos 成为一个强大、多功能的基础
端到端金融时间序列分析模型。我们的预训练模型是
可在 https://github.com/shiyu-coder/Kronos 公开获取。
papers.titleZh: Kronos：金融市场语言的基础模型

papers.title: MOSS-Image Technical Report
papers.summary: Recent closed-source image generation systems can produce diverse visual content from simple compositions to information-dense graphics, yet open-weight text-to-image models still struggle with dense text and intricate layouts. To narrow this gap, we introduce MOSS-Image, an open generation system that combines high-fidelity visual synthesis with intent-aware composition. First, we pretrain a 5B single-stream diffusion transformer (DiT) from scratch with a carefully designed recipe, enabling bilingual long-form text rendering and precise layout control. Second, we develop an intention-aware agentic prompt enhancement (PE) module that translates diverse user requests into detailed content and layout specifications. Together, they enable MOSS-Image to generate text-rich and layout-coherent images. We further introduce LongLongTextBench (LLTB) for evaluating long-form English and Chinese text rendering, and RealLayoutArena (RLA) for end-to-end layout-rich generation. MOSS-Image achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-weight models on LLTB, with an average text coverage of 96.3%. On RLA, MOSS-Image ranks second in the end-to-end system comparison, while its backbone ranks first among generators evaluated with shared enhanced prompts. We will release the model, training recipe, and evaluation framework to support further research and promote the text-to-image community.
papers.summaryZh: 最近的闭源图像生成系统可以生成从简单的构图到信息密集的图形的各种视觉内容，但开放权重文本到图像模型仍然难以应对密集的文本和复杂的布局。为了缩小这一差距，我们引入了 MOSS-Image，这是一个开放的生成系统，它将高保真视觉合成与意图感知合成相结合。首先，我们使用精心设计的配方从头开始预训练 5B 单流扩散变压器 (DiT)，从而实现双语长文本渲染和精确的布局控制。其次，我们开发了一个意图感知代理提示增强（PE）模块，将不同的用户请求转化为详细的内容和布局规范。它们共同使 MOSS-Image 能够生成文本丰富且布局一致的图像。我们进一步引入了用于评估长格式英文和中文文本渲染的 LongLongTextBench (LLTB)，以及用于端到端丰富布局生成的 RealLayoutArena (RLA)。 MOSS-Image 在 LLTB 上的开放权重模型中实现了最先进的性能，平均文本覆盖率为 96.3%。在 RLA 上，MOSS-Image 在端到端系统比较中排名第二，而其骨干网在使用共享增强提示评估的生成器中排名第一。我们将发布模型、训练配方和评估框架，以支持进一步的研究并促进文本到图像社区的发展。

papers.title: Hy-Nomas: Towards Free-form Interactive World Generation
papers.summary: Interactive world generation requires models to follow successive commands while preserving relevant history and action consequences. We present Hy-Nomas, a video world model with an 8B diffusion backbone that supports free-form text instructions and continuous camera control across multiple interaction turns. It generates variable-length segments conditioned on current inputs and cached history. Our central design aligns structured video captions with action-aware causal attention: descriptive context remains accessible across segments, while action instructions are restricted to their intended temporal windows. A vision-language Prompt Enhancer (PE) translates user requests and multimodal interaction histories into structured conditions for the next segment. A multi-stage curriculum progressively introduces causal generation, text interaction, camera control, and training on model-generated histories, followed by diffusion distillation. In human evaluation, Hy-Nomas shows superior performance over existing world models. We release model weights, code and benchmarks, together with a lightweight adaptation workflow, to support reproducible research on interactive world generation.
papers.summaryZh: 交互式世界的生成要求模型遵循连续的命令，同时保留相关的历史和行动后果。我们推出了 Hy-Nomas，这是一种具有 8B 扩散主干的视频世界模型，支持自由格式文本指令和跨多个交互回合的连续摄像机控制。它根据当前输入和缓存的历史记录生成可变长度的段。我们的中心设计将结构化视频字幕与动作感知因果注意力结合起来：描述性上下文仍然可以跨片段访问，而动作指令仅限于其预期的时间窗口。视觉语言提示增强器 (PE) 将用户请求和多模式交互历史转换为下一个片段的结构化条件。多阶段课程逐步介绍因果生成、文本交互、摄像机控制和模型生成历史的训练，然后进行扩散蒸馏。在人类评估中，Hy-Nomas 显示出优于现有世界模型的性能。我们发布模型权重、代码和基准，以及轻量级适应工作流程，以支持交互式世界生成的可重复研究。
papers.titleZh: Hy-Nomas：迈向自由形式的互动世界一代

papers.title:
OpenDevin: An Open Platform for AI Software Developers as Generalist
  Agents
papers.summary:
Software is one of the most powerful tools that we humans have at our
disposal; it allows a skilled programmer to interact with the world in complex
and profound ways. At the same time, thanks to improvements in large language
models (LLMs), there has also been a rapid development in AI agents that
interact with and affect change in their surrounding environments. In this
paper, we introduce OpenDevin, a platform for the development of powerful and
flexible AI agents that interact with the world in similar ways to those of a
human developer: by writing code, interacting with a command line, and browsing
the web. We describe how the platform allows for the implementation of new
agents, safe interaction with sandboxed environments for code execution,
coordination between multiple agents, and incorporation of evaluation
benchmarks. Based on our currently incorporated benchmarks, we perform an
evaluation of agents over 15 challenging tasks, including software engineering
(e.g., SWE-Bench) and web browsing (e.g., WebArena), among others. Released
under the permissive MIT license, OpenDevin is a community project spanning
academia and industry with more than 1.3K contributions from over 160
contributors and will improve going forward.
papers.summaryZh:
软件是我们人类拥有的最强大的工具之一
处置；它允许熟练的程序员以复杂的方式与世界互动
和深刻的方法。同时得益于大语言的改进
模型（法学硕士），人工智能代理也得到了快速发展，
与周围环境相互作用并影响其变化。在这个
论文中，我们介绍了 OpenDevin，一个用于开发功能强大且
flexible AI agents that interact with the world in similar ways to those of a
human developer: by writing code, interacting with a command line, and browsing
网络。我们描述了该平台如何允许实施新的
代理，与沙盒环境安全交互以执行代码，
多个主体之间的协调以及评估的结合
基准。 Based on our currently incorporated benchmarks, we perform an
对代理进行超过 15 项挑战性任务的评估，包括软件工程
（例如，SWE-Bench）和网页浏览（例如，WebArena）等。已发布
在 MIT 许可下，OpenDevin 是一个社区项目，涵盖
academia and industry with more than 1.3K contributions from over 160
贡献者并将继续改进。
papers.titleZh:
OpenDevin：面向多面手的人工智能软件开发人员的开放平台
  代理商

papers.title:
Efficient Memory Management for Large Language Model Serving with
  PagedAttention
papers.summary:
High throughput serving of large language models (LLMs) requires batching
sufficiently many requests at a time. However, existing systems struggle
because the key-value cache (KV cache) memory for each request is huge and
grows and shrinks dynamically. When managed inefficiently, this memory can be
significantly wasted by fragmentation and redundant duplication, limiting the
batch size. To address this problem, we propose PagedAttention, an attention
algorithm inspired by the classical virtual memory and paging techniques in
operating systems. On top of it, we build vLLM, an LLM serving system that
achieves (1) near-zero waste in KV cache memory and (2) flexible sharing of KV
cache within and across requests to further reduce memory usage. Our
evaluations show that vLLM improves the throughput of popular LLMs by
2-4times with the same level of latency compared to the state-of-the-art
systems, such as FasterTransformer and Orca. The improvement is more pronounced
with longer sequences, larger models, and more complex decoding algorithms.
vLLM's source code is publicly available at
https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm
papers.summaryZh:
大型语言模型 (LLM) 的高吞吐量服务需要批处理
一次有足够多的请求。然而，现有系统却举步维艰
因为每个请求的键值缓存（KV缓存）内存巨大并且
动态增长和收缩。当管理效率低下时，该内存可能会被
碎片和冗余重复造成了极大的浪费，限制了
批量大小。为了解决这个问题，我们提出PagedAttention，一个注意力机制
算法的灵感来自经典的虚拟内存和分页技术
操作系统。在此基础上，我们构建了 vLLM，一个 LLM 服务系统，
实现 (1) KV 缓存内存近乎零浪费和 (2) KV 灵活共享
在请求内和请求之间进行缓存，以进一步减少内存使用。我们的
评估表明，vLLM 通过以下方式提高了流行 LLM 的吞吐量：
与最先进的技术相比，相同延迟水平下的 2-4 倍
系统，例如 FasterTransformer 和 Orca。改善效果更加明显
具有更长的序列、更大的模型和更复杂的解码算法。
vLLM 的源代码可在以下位置公开获取：
https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm
papers.titleZh:
大型语言模型的高效内存管理
  分页注意力

papers.title: nanoMuse: An Open-Source Personal Agent for Every Device You Own
papers.summary: Assistants from 2011 answered and waited, and agents from 2023 did a task and stopped. In September 2026 Meta's Muse showed an agent for one person, with accounts, devices, memory and a conversation that lasts, closed, in a vendor's cloud, in one country. Such an agent is expected to act on a person's accounts and devices, remember them across weeks, speak first when it is worth it, and answer for what it did. It is a kind of software, not a model, and until now had no open counterpart. This report defines the personal agent in five questions and three horizons. It reads how Muse is built from Meta's public record and a copy of its production prompt, each statement marked by its source. It then presents nanoMuse, the open-source counterpart under the GPL-3.0, one agent on every device a person owns, with hands on the phone's screen and the computer's. They share one conversation over a relay anyone can run; every action goes through a Sentinel, memory is files the person can read, and the model is their choice. Its size and cost are given as estimates. What is open, memory with provenance, an evaluation suite for the hands and an open model for them, is set out as a roadmap.
papers.summaryZh: 2011 年的助理接听并等待，2023 年的客服人员完成任务后停下来。 2026 年 9 月，Meta 的 Muse 展示了一个人的代理，拥有账户、设备、内存和在一个国家的供应商云中持续、封闭的对话。这样的代理应该对一个人的账户和设备采取行动，在数周内记住它们，在值得的时候首先发言，并对其所做的事情负责。它是一种软件，而不是一种模型，并且迄今为止还没有开放的对应产品。本报告从五个问题和三个视野对个人代理人进行了定义。它读取了 Muse 是如何根据 Meta 的公共记录及其生产提示的副本构建的，每个语句都标有其来源。然后介绍了 nanoMuse，这是 GPL-3.0 下的开源对应产品，一个人拥有的每台设备上都有一个代理，可以将手放在手机屏幕和计算机屏幕上。他们通过任何人都可以运行的中继共享一次对话；每个动作都会经过哨兵，内存是人们可以读取的文件，模型是他们的选择。其尺寸和成本仅作为估计值给出。什么是开放的、有来源的记忆、针对双手的评估套件以及针对它们的开放模型，被作为路线图列出。
papers.titleZh: nanoMuse：适用于您拥有的每台设备的开源个人代理

papers.title: Prism: Dynamic Sparse Attention for Native 2K Joint Video-Audio Generation Model Training
papers.summary: Natively training joint video-audio generation models at higher resolutions empowers them to learn richer visual details and sharper motion dynamics. However, full attention incurs quadratic cost and, as resolution increases, spreads attention over increasingly redundant tokens, diluting learning signals for informative content and disrupting pretrained priors. Existing sparse attention methods either target training-free acceleration or overlook the unique structure of joint video-audio data, where cross-modal interactions are inherently concentrated around sound-producing regions. To address this, we propose Prism, a dynamic sparse attention framework for natively training joint video-audio generation models at 2K. In particular, Prism organizes the token sequence into spatiotemporal macro-zones, enabling the attention structure to adapt to local content. For each zone, it estimates local information structure via video feature variance along the channel and feature norms from the audio-to-video cross-attention, jointly capturing how visual content varies directionally and how strongly audio influences each visual region. Based on these signals, Prism dynamically assigns a tailored block shape to each zone, applying finer partitioning along axes of rapid visual content variation and strong audio-visual coupling. This encourages tokens within each block to remain semantically coherent, allowing block-level features to capture both visual content and joint video-audio interaction patterns. Prism further adopts a hybrid block selection strategy to dynamically determine per-query sparsity. Experiments show that Prism achieves 2.5times training speedup compared to full attention, while surpassing it in generation quality.
papers.summaryZh: 以更高分辨率本地训练联合视频音频生成模型使他们能够学习更丰富的视觉细节和更清晰的运动动态。然而，充分的注意力会产生二次成本，并且随着分辨率的提高，注意力会分散到越来越冗余的标记上，从而稀释信息内容的学习信号并破坏预先训练的先验。现有的稀疏注意力方法要么以免训练加速为目标，要么忽视联合视频音频数据的独特结构，其中跨模式交互本质上集中在发声区域周围。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 Prism，一种动态稀疏注意力框架，用于本地训练 2K 联合视频音频生成模型。特别是，Prism 将 token 序列组织成时空宏观区域，使注意力结构能够适应本地内容。对于每个区域，它通过沿通道的视频特征方差和音频到视频交叉注意力的特征规范来估计局部信息结构，共同捕获视觉内容如何方向变化以及音频对每个视觉区域的影响程度。基于这些信号，Prism 动态地为每个区域分配定制的块形状，沿着快速视觉内容变化和强视听耦合的轴应用更精细的分区。这鼓励每个块内的令牌保持语义一致，从而允许块级功能捕获视觉内容和联合视频音频交互模式。 Prism进一步采用混合块选择策略来动态确定每个查询的稀疏性。实验表明，与 Full Attention 相比，Prism 实现了 2.5 倍的训练加速，同时在生成质量上也超越了 Full Attention。
papers.titleZh: Prism：用于原生 2K 联合视音频生成模型训练的动态稀疏注意力

papers.title:
MinerU2.5: A Decoupled Vision-Language Model for Efficient
  High-Resolution Document Parsing
papers.summary:
We introduce MinerU2.5, a 1.2B-parameter document parsing vision-language
model that achieves state-of-the-art recognition accuracy while maintaining
exceptional computational efficiency. Our approach employs a coarse-to-fine,
two-stage parsing strategy that decouples global layout analysis from local
content recognition. In the first stage, the model performs efficient layout
analysis on downsampled images to identify structural elements, circumventing
the computational overhead of processing high-resolution inputs. In the second
stage, guided by the global layout, it performs targeted content recognition on
native-resolution crops extracted from the original image, preserving
fine-grained details in dense text, complex formulas, and tables. To support
this strategy, we developed a comprehensive data engine that generates diverse,
large-scale training corpora for both pretraining and fine-tuning. Ultimately,
MinerU2.5 demonstrates strong document parsing ability, achieving
state-of-the-art performance on multiple benchmarks, surpassing both
general-purpose and domain-specific models across various recognition tasks,
while maintaining significantly lower computational overhead.
papers.summaryZh:
我们介绍MinerU2.5，一个1.2B参数的文档解析视觉语言
该模型可实现最先进的识别精度，同时保持
卓越的计算效率。我们的方法采用从粗到细的方法，
将全局布局分析与局部布局分析分离的两阶段解析策略
内容识别。第一阶段，模型进行高效布局
分析下采样图像以识别结构元素，规避
处理高分辨率输入的计算开销。在第二个
舞台上，以全球布局为导向，进行有针对性的内容识别
从原始图像中提取的原始分辨率作物，保留
密集文本、复杂公式和表格中的细粒度细节。支持
根据这一策略，我们开发了一个全面的数据引擎，可以生成不同的、
用于预训练和微调的大规模训练语料库。最终，
MinerU2.5展现出强大的文档解析能力，实现
在多个基准测试中具有最先进的性能，超越了两者
跨各种识别任务的通用和特定领域模型，
同时保持显着较低的计算开销。
papers.titleZh:
MinerU2.5：一种高效的解耦视觉语言模型
  高分辨率文档解析
